name: 斑枭
description: 和洛克相交甚少的种族，拥有比较强的野性和攻击性。如果在领地内看到生面孔，可能俯冲下来攻击对方，拥有出色的深度感知能力和夜视能力，即使藏在阴影处也难以逃过它的双眼。
descriptionEn: A race that has little contact with Roco, possessing strong wildness and aggression. If it spots a stranger within its territory, it may dive down to attack. It has excellent depth perception and night vision; even hidden in shadows, it is hard to escape its eyes.
